items.statement: The submission preserves the supplied neutral singlet molecular identities and explicitly documents conformer handling, geometry convergence/stationarity, amine-site mapping and descriptor definitions.
items.expected: All ODA, 6FODA, PFMB and TMC records are charge 0/multiplicity 1 with unchanged connectivity; the report states a reproducible conformer and convergence procedure and identifies the amine sites.

items.statement: The inter-benzene dihedral is measured using C1–C2–X–C3, with X=O for ODA/6FODA and X=C for PFMB.
items.expected: The report states this selector and uses equivalent atom identities consistently for all three diamines.

items.statement: The reported nucleophilicity indices are ODA 4.26 eV, 6FODA 3.68 eV and PFMB 3.56 eV.
items.expected: The submitted per-molecule descriptor values identify the descriptor and units and are quantitatively close to 4.26, 3.68 and 3.56 eV for the named molecules.

items.statement: The revised multidescriptor interpretation gives ODA > 6FODA > PFMB and reports optimized inter-benzene dihedrals of 75.2°, 81.6° and 77.1°.
items.expected: The ordering field states ODA > 6FODA > PFMB and the three dihedral values are close to the reported values, with molecule identity retained.

items.statement: The descriptor comparison is an intrinsic gas-phase model interpretation, not a direct experimental kinetic constant.
items.expected: The conclusion states this limitation and does not claim that the calculation alone is an experimental rate measurement.
